title: Help fund early cancer detection research, built in public
md:
This research is independent, with no institutional or company funding. I fund it myself, together with people who choose to help. Every dollar spent on rented computing is listed, run by run, in the public [run ledger](Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/RUNS.md).

To help: **[Help fund early cancer detection research, built in public]({url})** (GoFundMe). To follow the work: [FOLLOW.md](FOLLOW.md).
